title: Discoverability
description: Can an agent find the site, its sitemap, its product URLs and its agent-facing index files?

title: Bot access control
description: Do robots.txt, response headers and the WAF let shopping agents in, and are AI-training rules explicit rather than accidental?

title: Content accessibility
description: Can an agent read product content without executing JavaScript, and can it ask for Markdown instead of HTML?

title: Protocol discovery
description: Does the site publish machine-readable discovery documents (MCP, API catalog, OAuth, Agent Skills, A2A)? Low weight: expected to be absent on most stores today.

title: Catalog exposure
description: Can an agent read the catalog as data: Store API, feeds, and a sitemap that agrees with them?

title: Product structured data
description: Do product pages carry schema.org Product markup with live price, availability, variants, shipping and returns?

title: Product identity
description: Can an agent match products to real-world entities through GTIN, brand, MPN and SKU, the way Google, Meta, ACP and UCP require?

title: Merchant trust and policies
description: Are the policies a checkout needs (returns, shipping, privacy, terms) and the merchant's identity findable and readable?

title: Checkout and payment protocols
description: Can an agent start a transaction: UCP manifest, ACP checkout, payment handlers, guest checkout and cart API?
